title: Dr Frost Arctic Cherry Cola Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Nic Salt Cherry Cola Ice brings together the nostalgic taste of sweet Cherry and the fizzy tang of classic Cola, perfectly balanced with a cooling menthol twist. This bold and refreshing blend delivers a layered flavour experience, ideal for vapers seeking a unique combination of fruity sweetness and icy refreshment. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid features a double-concentrated Bar Salts flavour, replicating the intense taste profiles associated with disposable vapes. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Cherry Cola Ice Nic Salt is crafted for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits and low-powered devices, providing smooth throat hits and quick nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Cherry Cola Ice is a versatile choice for adult smokers and vapers who enjoy bold and refreshing flavours.
